channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Canada
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: Cashmere Collection 2026 voting contest – Kruger Products (Cashmere)
item.description: Prize: $5,000 CAD grand prize. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Vote for your favourite design and enter name and email at CashmereCollection.ca; 1 entry per day. Canada, age of majority

item.title: The Nature Photography Contest 2026 – The Nature Photography Contest
item.description: Prize: €2,000 in cash prizes. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Upload nature photos on the contest website. Open internationally

item.title: Matty Matheson x Get Cracking Contest – Egg Farmers of Canada
item.description: Prize: 10 prize packs (ARV min. $400 CAD each): MATHESON cast iron pan, co-branded merch and kitchen gear. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form at eggs.ca; 1 entry per person. Canada incl. Quebec, age of majority

item.title: Bathorium Presents: Soak in St. Lucia – Bathorium
item.description: Prize: Five nights for two at Sugar Beach, A Viceroy Resort in St. Lucia, plus $2,000 toward flights. Deadline: December 6, 2026. Enter free with your name and email (purchases, referrals and social actions add bonus entries but are not needed). Canada (excl. Quebec) and US, 18+

item.title: Canadel "Buying Local Pays Off" Contest – Canadel
item.description: Prize: 5 prizes by region; no-purchase entrants win a $4,000 Canadel gift certificate. Deadline: December 10, 2026. No-purchase entry: online form at canadel.com/BuyingLocalPaysOff/nopurchase, 1 per person. Canada incl. Quebec, age of majority; skill-testing question

item.title: Henry's Canon PowerShot V1 Email Subscription Giveaway – Henry's
item.description: Prize: Canon PowerShot V1 camera (ARV $1,249.99 CAD), one per quarter. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to Henry's email list and confirm; 1 entry per quarter. Canada excl. Quebec, age of majority

item.title: Transitions Canada Contest: GoldLeaf train trip for two – Transitions Canada
item.description: Prize: 3-day luxury rail trip for two (Vancouver–Jasper) with flights, ARV about $16,000. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the form at transitionscontest.ca (quiz, newsletter and colour pick give up to 3 extra chances). Canada, age of majority

item.title: Viking Q4 2026 "2027 8-Day Journey" Sweepstakes (Canada) – Viking River Cruises
item.description: Prize: 8-day Viking cruise of your choice for two including airfare (example values $24,396–$40,596 CAD). Deadline: December 31, 2026. Fill in the entry form at vc-ca.com/sweepstakes; 1 entry per person. Canada excl. Quebec, 21+; skill-testing question

item.title: 24 Days of DHL Virtual Advent Calendar 2026 – Deutsche Post DHL
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (2025: daily prize draws with prizes that changed each day). 2025: answer the day's question and fill in the entry form; each door stays open 48 hours. 18+
